title: Der Klassiker league scorers
brief: Name the ten players with the most Bundesliga goals in Bayern Munich against Dortmund matches since 2000/01. Own goals do not count.

notes.Robert Lewandowski: Lewandowski scored 23 for Bayern and 1 for Dortmund (April 2012).
notes.Mario Gotze: Gotze scored 2 for Dortmund and 2 for Bayern.
notes.Mats Hummels: Hummels scored 3 (2 for Dortmund, 1 for Bayern), just outside. His 2019 own goal does not count.
notes.Ewerthon: Ewerthon scored 3 for Dortmund, just outside.
notes.Roque Santa Cruz: Santa Cruz scored 3 for Bayern, just outside.
notes.Gregor Kobel: Kobel's 2023 own goal does not count.

checks: Every one of the 52 league meetings from 2000/01 to 2025/26 was read from its Transfermarkt match report and checked goal by goal (score after the goal and scorer) against the fussballdaten.de match page; all 180 goals agree, including the two own goals (Hummels 2019, Kobel 2023), which are left out. Every final score also matches football-data.co.uk. Five players have 4 goals, so they share 8th to 10th as a pool.
